store.summary: Nomad Packet Capture: mirror-port or inline-tap pcap with AV filter presets
store.description: Part of the Nomad tools by Tech Nomad Ted, TheTechNomad.com. Turns the CardputerZero into a pocket packet capture box for AV networks: plug the Ethernet port into a switch mirror (SPAN) port, pick a filter and start. Presets for Dante (with or without audio), PTP clock, AES67/RTP/SAP, NDI, control systems (Crestron, Q-SYS, Extron, PJLink), multicast/IGMP, ARP/DHCP and LLDP/CDP, plus host IP, port and custom tcpdump filters. Time and size limits or a ring buffer, live packet, rate and drop counters and a protocol breakdown on screen. Captures keep running in the background and stop safely before the card fills. Inline tap mode: add a USB Ethernet adapter and the CardputerZero sits in the cable between two devices as an invisible bridge (no IP, 802.1X and LLDP pass through), starting by itself when the adapter is plugged in. With HDMI connected a live packet viewer opens on the desktop. Get files off by scanning the on-screen QR code (download or delete in any browser) or copying to a USB stick.
